title: fr-CA: 'Enable Set/Strike Labor Minutes' and 'Apply Set/Strike Labor Minutes' share one translated label — in History and on the Local Information form — so a French user cannot tell the two apart
requirementSource: NM-3937 AC9 'French (Canada) and Spanish (Mexico) labels are translated according to the application's localization resources' and scenario NM3937-18 ('History tab and representative headers are translated'). Two distinct settings must remain distinguishable after translation — es-MX translates them distinctly ('Habilitar Min Mano Obra Montaje/Desm' / 'Aplicar Min de Mano de Obra Montaje/Desm').
stepsToReproduce: Open the account menu (sidebar footer, 'prd click auto'), hover 'Language', click 'French (Canada) fr-CA'.
Open the Location Management History tab and read the headers of columns 41 and 42 (English: 'Enable Set/Strike Labor Minutes', 'Apply Set/Strike Labor Minutes').
Open Basic Information > Local Information and read the labels of the same two checkboxes.
Switch the language back to English (US).
expectedBehavior: The two settings carry two different French labels (as they do in English and Spanish), in both the History headers and the form.
actualBehavior: History columns 41 and 42 are both 'Activer le temps de main-d’œuvre pour montage/démontage'; the two Local Information checkboxes are both 'Activer les Temps de travail de montage/démontage'. A French user cannot tell which checkbox enables and which applies set/strike labor minutes, nor which history column recorded which change. (The form and the History also use two different French wordings for the same setting.)
